column24: Essentially flat vs v25 (295.21) -- a 3.77s LOCAL gain (vs the 2-arm blend) produced only a 0.27s BOARD delta, wrong direction. Validated on two independent local surfaces BEFORE submitting (forward test +4.71s, seasonal split +3.76s, both positive at 8-10/10 airports), so this is read as board-level noise on a real small edge, not a defect in the recipe. Local-to-board offset (~47-51s) matches v25's own offset, not unique to this arm. Full investigation: memory/prc2026_submission_mechanics.md 2026-09-15 entries, TAXI_OUT_DRIVERS.md sec.2o.

column24: Confirms the local sweep decisively: -113.2s vs v19 (382.9174), same architecture, only the outlier policy differs. Local val gap alone was +60.1s (272.9 keep_all vs 333.0 winsor_7200) -- board gap is even larger. Prediction-distribution comparison on the same ranking rows shows the mechanism directly: median/mean nearly identical to keep_all (958/1028.6 vs 958/1033.0) but max collapses from 40,640s to 8,148s, right at the training cap -- the real, learnable 7,200-80,000s tail this project's OUTLIER_POLICIES comment documents gets truncated away. v25 (295.21) unaffected, still the standing best.
